text: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical 9:16 reel using all five in this order: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. The background details and transitions are your call, as long as the background stays softly blurred and each whole foreground photo stays visible. Keep it silent, with no music or text.
